SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST is a premium, gap filling, water based, multi purpose construction adhesive providing strong initial grab and high bond strength.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST can be used on most substrates due to its excellent adhesion.
s: Fixing polystyrene wall panels
Replacing loose tiles on walls
Skirting boards, architraves and trims to walls
Bonding panels and sheeting to internal wall studs
Bonding particleboard, plywood, fibre cement and strip flooring to joists
Bonding metal, glass, aluminium,concrete, paper and cork

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Packaging
Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion. All loose flaking material must be removed and light sanding is recommended.

SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST will adhere to damp (not wet) substrates but drying times may be extended. Substrates should be above 5°C. Do not bond 2 non-porous substrates ensure that one surface is porous.

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: After the necessary substrate preparation, prepare the end of the cartridge before or after inserting into the sealant gun then fit the nozzle. Apply in beads, strips or spots at intervals of a few centimetres each. Use hand pressure only to fix the components to be bonded into position before skinning of the adhesive occurs. Incorrectly positioned components can easily be repositioned for approximately 60 minutes after application.

For butt joints use adhesive on both panel edges. If necessary, use temporary adhesive tapes, wedges, or supports to hold the assembled components together during the initial curing time. Fresh, uncured adhesive remaining on the surface must be removed immediately. Final strength will be reached after complete curing of SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST, after 24 to 48 hours at +23°C, depending on the environmental conditions and adhesive layer thickness

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use detergent and water.

s: Protect from contact with water.
High humidity or poor ventilation will result in slow curing.
Not suitable where both surfaces are non-porous.
In applications where load bearing is required mechanical fasteners must be used.
Not suitable for bonding plank or engineered timbers to concrete floors.
Do not use in permanently damp/wet conditions.
